transcript:
SA: Kvarn Kaffe, Sara här.
C: Hej Sara, Petra at Kontoret Söder. The coworking place on Hornsgatan.
SA: Hi Petra! How's it going over there?
C: Full house. We took over the floor above us in September, so eh, twice the people and twice the coffee.
SA: Congratulations. So a bigger order this time?
C: Yes. Sixty kilo of the House Espresso for the machines.
SA: Sixty kilo House Espresso.
C: And then the organic one for the brewers, the Breakfast Blend. Forty kilo.
SA: Forty kilo Organic Breakfast Blend. So that's a hundred kilo in total.
C: A hundred on the dot. Good, that should last us until Christmas.
SA: Should do!
C: And the new espresso machine is enormous, it looks like a spaceship. Everyone wants to press the buttons.
SA: Ha, sounds fun. I'll send the quote over.
C: Tack så mycket, hej!
